description: Minor, patch, digest and pin updates are automerged via GitHub auto-merge once CI (build, vet, staticcheck, unit and MySQL 8.0/8.4 acceptance tests) and the review requirement pass.
Major updates and Go toolchain bumps always stay manual.

packageRules.description: Automerge low-risk updates; majors are intentionally not matched.
Automerge GitHub Actions minor/patch updates; majors stay manual.
Go toolchain bumps change the supported/built Go version; review manually.
